newsitem.title: USA: Dow Jones index gains more than 100 points.
newsitem.headline: Dow Jones index gains more than 100 points.

text.p: The Dow Jones industrial average extended its surge in late trading Thursday, gaining more than 100 points as bonds jumped on tame wholesale price data for December.

At 3:10 p.m. EST, the Dow was up 100.44 points at 6,649.92, which surpassed Tuesday's record close of 6,600.66. The 30-year Treasury bond rose 30/32 after the Labour Department's report on December producer prices, driving its yield down to 6.76 percent from 6.84 percent on Wednesday.
